titles.title: Get Out of My Romance Fantasy

description:
A world trapped in a time loop that resets every year. 

No matter what happens—whether you get married or become rich—everything returns to the way it was after one year. 

Aileen, who has been reincarnated into a romance-fantasy novel, seeks out the original heroine, Delia, in an attempt to break the 100th repetition of the time loop. Ever since possessing Aileen's body, there has always been one thing she couldn't understand: how could the perfect heroine, Delia, have suddenly become a shut-in? Believing that the changed Delia is the cause of the time loop, Aileen decides to make her marry the male lead, Bennett, just as in the original story. But then she discovers something completely unexpected... Bennett has been possessed by Aileen's ex-boyfriend?!

 Will Aileen manage to get the two of them married and finally escape the endless time loop?
